disclaimer.short: Follows BOR calendar usage. Not an official product of the Romanian Patriarchate.
disclaimer.long: Orthodox Calendar is an independent product that follows Romanian Patriarchate (BOR) liturgical calendar usage for feasts, ranks, and fasting. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Patriarhia Română. Synaxar texts and icons are our own editorial stubs — not copyrighted Patriarchate content.

about.title: About
about.body: This MVP (Phase 0 / start of Phase 1) demonstrates the calendar information architecture, shared API routes, and equal ES / PT / EN depth. Current-year data is a structural seed; full editorial coverage comes in later phases.
